video:video.video:title: The Paper Mountain — SemantiNote episode 1
video:video.video:description: Search by meaning, not keywords. Buried in 400 pages, Dave describes the contract he needs — and SemantiNote finds the note with zero matching words.

video:video.video:title: Meeting Memory — SemantiNote episode 2
video:video.video:description: Kevin agreed to four things and remembers none of them. SemantiNote recorded and transcribed the meeting, so every promise is searchable.

video:video.video:title: Grandpa's Passwords — SemantiNote episode 3
video:video.video:description: 47 sticky notes, zero working logins. The encrypted Secret Safe keeps every password in one private place — no more lockouts.

video:video.video:title: The All-Nighter — SemantiNote episode 4
video:video.video:description: 3 AM, four notebooks, one missing page. Ken just asks his own notes how cells turn food into energy — and gets the answer instantly.

video:video.video:title: The $16,200 Bill — SemantiNote episode 5
video:video.video:description: A company's cloud-AI bill won't stop climbing. One employee shows the fix: AI that runs on your own computer, for free.

video:video.video:title: The Lecture Nap — SemantiNote episode 6
video:video.video:description: Jamal sleeps through his 9 AM. SemantiNote recorded and summarized the whole lecture — so he still walks away with an A+.

video:video.video:title: The Data Leak — SemantiNote episode 7
video:video.video:description: Staff pasted client data into cloud chatbots 1,284 times. SemantiNote's AI runs locally — so sensitive data never leaves the machine.

video:video.video:title: The Hardcoded Key — SemantiNote episode 8
video:video.video:description: Leo's about to push his API key to the whole internet. He asks the built-in AI to review his code first — and dodges a disaster.

video:video.video:title: CSV in Seconds — SemantiNote episode 9
video:video.video:description: “Q2 token spend by Friday.” Sam drops the expense CSV into SemantiNote, asks a question, and has the numbers in seconds.

video:video.video:title: The Performance Review — SemantiNote episode 10
video:video.video:description: Nina's review is in an hour and she can't recall what she did all year. She asks a year of notes — and walks in completely ready.

video:video.video:title: The Origin Story — SemantiNote episode 11
video:video.video:description: Mike kept forgetting everything — meetings, passwords, where he put that file. So he built the private notes app he wished existed. This is how SemantiNote began.

video:video.video:title: Sticky Notes — SemantiNote episode 12
video:video.video:description: SemantiNote was built… but nobody had downloaded it. Too shy to pitch it out loud, Mike covered Boston in sticky notes to get the word out.

video:video.video:title: The Head of Sales — SemantiNote episode 13
video:video.video:description: Mike made his best friend Head of Sales. His friend made exactly zero sales. An honest, funny look at building a product from scratch.
